**Concerns:**
- `npm create vite@latest . -- --template react-ts` cancels when run inside an existing git repo with `--no-interactive` not preventing it. Workaround was to scaffold to `/tmp/vite-temp/myapp/` first and copy files over — all scaffolded files are identical to what the template produces.
